_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 87: 11-15 June 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord reminded him about delivering the packages and asked whether he remembers that on December 25th while he was giving gifts to his children God was giving gifts to his, that not all of those chariots of fire were able to deliver those gifts because people were not ready for them and refused to take them, and that he saw a chariot of fire turn around and go back into heaven with the package still on the back.
mentions.quote: not all of those chariots of fire was able to deliver those gifts
mentions.condition_text: if you are ready to receive it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an undelivered gift leaves no trace.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. This is the explanation for a promise that did not arrive, given after the date passed: the delivery was attempted and refused. It converts every unmet Christmas declaration into the hearer's failure to receive.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he is raising up not echoes but new voices that will take the baton from the elder generation and march on, and asking whether they understand, to stop looking to the past and look to what is coming and what God has for them to do, that they are closers built for pressure and that God saved the best for last.
mentions.quote: I'm raising up new voices that will take the baton from the olders
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no voice named and no time given.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not an abundant supply problem but a boldness problem because they would not take the land, that a whole generation had to die before they knew they were not the size of grasshoppers, that you are not a grasshopper, that giants may be all around in these last days and the enemy may look like he is surrounding them, but there are more with them than against them.
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an exhortation with no stated outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be people who are preaching and are there and then will be there no more, that the Lord is raising up new Davids and new ones who will take the baton, that he is putting in his dream team 2026, that he is cleansing and cleaning up his bride to bring the bride to his side, and speaks of the remnant that are awakened right now.
mentions.quote: He's putting in his dream team 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Prominent preachers leaving the scene during 2026 and new ones rising.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. People who are preaching and will be there no more is satisfied by any retirement, scandal or death in a year, and no name or count is given.

mentions.claim_text: He prays as they get ready to go into the Father's Day weekend next weekend and with the Fourth of July coming, says it is a fun time of year and then misspeaks that they want to have terrorist attacks, thanks God for peace over Jerusalem, and covers Billy and the others having their last week in Israel.
mentions.quote: we get ready to go into the Father's Day weekend next weekend
mentions.time_phrase: Father's Day weekend to the Fourth of July
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a prayer over a period, with nothing stated.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. The slip is a slip and is recorded as one; he plainly means they do not want attacks.

mentions.claim_text: He tells people to follow him on X for what is coming, says he truly believes that by 2028 they are going to censor, that if he is not on YouTube he will be on X, and that for about two hours last night his comments would not show up and comments on his videos were not happening, and that he does not know what was going on.
mentions.quote: by 2028, they're going to censor censor censor
mentions.falsify_match: His channel restricted or removed by 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. He marks this as belief rather than vision. A two-hour comment outage he cannot explain is offered as the early sign, which is a low bar: platform glitches are routine.

mentions.claim_text: He says that on March 14th he saw an alliance with Turkey and Syria in the days ahead that would be like a brother coming to their aid as Israel strikes Syria, describes them saying you are not going to do that and coming to the defence of Syria, and that he saw certain strikes coming against Iran but they were not as defensive over Iran as they were over Syria.
mentions.quote: I saw an alliance with Turkey and uh and Syria in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey intervening on Syria's behalf against Israeli strikes.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The 14 March origin is inside this corpus and datable, and the asymmetry he draws, defending Syria but not Iran, is specific enough to score.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Turkey taking over and making it impossible to go into the Black Sea, that he does not know if there are other ways, locates Ukraine on a map with his son, that he saw them controlling that to try to help Russia, references December 2nd, and prays for President Trump to have greater discernment.
mentions.quote: Turkey taking over and making it where it was impossible to go into
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey closing the straits in a way that favours Russia.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. This is a properly scoreable geopolitical claim: the Turkish straits are governed by a treaty, access is publicly observable, and closing them to help Russia would run against Turkey's current position.

mentions.claim_text: He says to look at October the 8th when they had not even gone to war with Iran and blown them up yet, that he was seeing into the future and the Lord was showing him there is going to be a major uprising with Iran, that he even said it and is telling them it is coming, and asks whether they see that it had not happened yet.
mentions.quote: there's going to be a major uprising with Iran
mentions.falsify_match: The 8 October recording carrying this before the escalation began.
mentions.falsify_miss: The recording does not, or postdates the escalation. The date is given and sits inside this corpus, so the priority claim is directly checkable. Major uprising with Iran is loose enough that the base rate matters when scoring it.

mentions.claim_text: He says that last summer he said there is peace for a little time but there is going to be an uprising again and it is coming with more to follow, that he warned them in October and they should go back and hear it again, that he is trying to tell them it is accurate and not flaky and they are not there to be flaky, and that he saw another escalation coming but this time said it would involve someone further.
mentions.quote: there's peace for a little time, but it's going to be an uprising again
mentions.falsify_match: Recordings from last summer and October matching what he says he said.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not match. Peace for a little time then an uprising again is a claim that covers both states in sequence, so it cannot be wrong about which one arrives, only about when.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if they listen to what the Lord was saying here on January 4th, Venezuela had just been invaded the night before on the 3rd, and the Lord was warning that Xi and Kim Jong-un were going to have a meeting and that he wants to offer him a truce like a friendship, and that the Lord said they are going to have a truce.
mentions.quote: he wants to offer him a a a truce like a friendship
mentions.falsify_match: A publicly announced meeting and understanding between the Chinese and North Korean leaders.
mentions.falsify_miss: No meeting. Two named living leaders and a stated outcome, with a dated origin inside this corpus, which makes this one of the cleaner geopolitical items here.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch Kim Jong-un rise up with China in the days ahead and that the spirit of the Lord said this on January 4th, that Putin and he are having a meeting and to watch what they do, and asks for the clip to be played again because he wants to paint the picture of where they are now in June.
mentions.quote: watch Kim Jong-un rise up with China in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: North Korea taking a visibly larger role alongside China and Russia.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Watch is not a prediction and rise up sets no threshold, so any diplomatic contact between the three satisfies it.
